playstyle.identity: Viktor is a scaling control mage who upgrades his abilities throughout the game. His laser and gravity field provide excellent zone control.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: upgrade abilities by farming (augmented abilities are stronger). Q shields and empowers next auto. W creates a slow field that stuns after delay. E fires a laser that can be bent. R creates a moving storm. Farm augments, control zones with W and R.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Viktor spikes with each augment (Q first usually) and after full upgrades. Luden's scales him. He's a late-game scaling mage.

passive.name: Glorious Evolution
passive.summary: Farm to upgrade abilities with Hex Core.
passive.details: Viktor starts with a Hex Core that upgrades. He gains Hex Fragments from killing minions and champions. At thresholds, he can augment his abilities.

abilities.name: Siphon Power
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt that shields you; next auto deals bonus damage. Augmented: speed boost.
abilities.details: Viktor fires a device that damages and returns to grant him a shield. His next auto deals bonus damage. Augmented: Also grants movement speed.

abilities.name: Gravity Field
abilities.summary: Create a zone that slows and stuns after duration. Augmented: slows more.
abilities.details: Viktor creates a field that slows enemies. After a delay or reaching full stacks, enemies inside are stunned. Augmented: Also pulls enemies toward the center.

abilities.name: Death Ray
abilities.summary: Fire a laser in a line that can be bent. Augmented: explodes after a delay.
abilities.details: Viktor fires a laser that he can direct, dealing damage in a line. Augmented: The laser also explodes after a delay.

abilities.name: Chaos Storm
abilities.summary: Create a storm that follows enemies and deals damage over time. Augmented: moves faster.
abilities.details: Viktor creates a chaos storm that deals damage and silences on impact, then deals damage over time while following enemies. Augmented: Storm moves faster.
